description.en: The number of resources. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
公网带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。

- 按固定带宽计费时，取值范围为10\~1000。
- 按使用流量计费时，取值范围为10\~200。
description.en:
The maximum public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.

- Valid values if you set InternetChargeType to PayByBandwidth: 10 to 1000.

- Valid values if you set InternetChargeType to InternetChargeType: 10 to 200.

description.zh: 按月购买云电脑时的时长包类型。当`ResourceType`为`DesktopMonthPackage`时，该字段必填。
description.en: The type of hourly plan if you use the Monthly Subscription billing method. If you set `ResourceType` to `DesktopMonthPackage`, you must specify this parameter.

description.zh:
共享型云电脑的数量，默认值为1。

> 当`ResourceType`为`DesktopGroup`时，该值有效。
description.en:
The number of cloud computer shares. Default value: 1.

> This parameter takes effect only if you set `ResourceType` to `DesktopGroup`.

description.zh:
资源规格。

- 当`ResourceType`为`Desktop`时，该字段必填。可以调用[DescribeDesktopTypes](~~DescribeDesktopTypes~~)查询可用的值（对应`DesktopTypeId`的值）。

- 当`ResourceType`为`DesktopGroup`时，取值为`large`。

- 当`ResourceType`为`Bandwidth`时，可以不传入该参数。
description.en:
The specifications of the resource.

- This parameter is required if you set `ResourceType` to `Desktop`. You can call the [DescribeDesktopTypes](~~DescribeDesktopTypes~~) to query the available cloud computer types that correspond to the value of `DesktopTypeId`.

- If you set `ResourceType` to `DesktopGroup`, set the value of this parameter to `large`.

- If you set `ResourceType` to `Bandwidth`, you can leave this parameter empty.

description.zh: 互联网访问包的计费方式。
description.en: The metering method for network traffic.

description.zh:
购买时长。取值范围由参数`PeriodUnit`的值决定。

- `PeriodUnit`为`Hour`时，取值范围为：1。
- `PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围为：1、2、3、6。
- `PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围为：1、2、3。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The subscription duration. The valid values of this parameter vary based on the value of `PeriodUnit`.

- If you set `PeriodUnit` to `Hour`, set the value of this parameter to 1.

- If you set `PeriodUnit` to `Month`, set the value of this parameter to 1, 2, 3, or 6.

- If you set `PeriodUnit` to `Year`, set the value of this parameter to 1, 2, or 3.

Default value: 1.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [](t2167755.xdita#)operation to query the regions supported by EDS.

description.zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数。
description.en: User ID of the resource owner in resale mode. This parameter is not required in non-resale mode.
The category of the system disk.

description.zh: 系统盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见[ESSD云盘](~~122389~~)。
description.en: Performance level of the system disk. You can configure the disk performance level when the cloud desktop instance type is graphics-optimized or high clock speed. For differences among performance levels of disks, see [](t583241.xdita#).

description.zh: 系统盘大小。单位：GiB。当`ResourceType`为`Desktop`时，该字段必填。
description.en: The size of the system disk. Unit: GiB. If you set `ResourceType` to `Desktop`, you must specify this parameter.
The category of the data disk.

description.zh: 数据盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见[ESSD云盘](~~122389~~)。
description.en: Performance level of the data disk. You can specify the disk performance level when the WUYING Workspace instance type is set to graphics-optimized or high clock speed. For differences between performance levels of disks, see [](t583241.xdita#).
The size of the data disk. Unit: GiB.
